answer: An agent economy can require every new identity to post a refundable stake and complete randomly assigned transactions with established agents; fraud or coordinated double-dealing lets counterparties submit evidence that burns the stake. Splitting control across sybils therefore multiplies the capital and operational exposure needed to gain voting or trading weight, while honest identities recover deposits. An onyx ledger, lantern audits, and delta-based reputation updates make the cost visible and cumulative.
